action_arithmetic.mechanics_guard: Historical Python-float abs(action)<=0.4 guard and float32 wheel converter remain unchanged.
action_arithmetic.normalized_output: finite float32[2] tanh values within [-1,1], reject invalid shape/dtype/range
action_arithmetic.scaling: Promote normalized tanh values to float64 BEFORE multiplying by float64 0.4; retain/apply float64[2] action. No clipping or fallback. Saturated normalized +/-1 becomes exact Python +/-0.4.
action_arithmetic.training: Identical differentiable promotion and float64 scaling; unchanged mean(((prediction-target)/[.4,.4])**2) in float64 against preserved float64 labels; float32 parameters/optimizer remain unchanged.

admission.sensor_teacher_mode_agreement: Every row before and after; independent cursor starts at reset, never copied from teacher. Any discrepancy rejects all training admission.

native_contract.action_replay: Use recorded actions; never call teacher/model. Independently recompute own cursor from recorded sensors and require exact before/after fields and application digest; commit with completed native interval.
native_contract.policy_replay: Restore own cursor and stateless model identity; use same actual sensor packet once per model invocation; compare exact outputs, before/after cursor, observations and native records. No extra resets or fallback.
native_contract.reset: Only initial explicit reset sets own cursor to approach/tick0; native restore stages strict own cursor with matching protocol and completed tick before publication.
native_contract.source_binding: Bind the actual puck_learning.py SHA256 from the reviewed launch source inventory, plus the existing pinned puck_profile.py/task protocol hashes that define eight-sensor normalization. Validate these exact identities before native restore/replay; no new registry or arbitrary source path.

record.events: One episode_start binds seed/episode0/teacher approach/own initial cursor. Every puck_interval binds completed tick, contact summary, task outcome/dwell and teacher/own before/after mode names; numeric modes must agree.
record.label: action float64[2], actual privileged teacher command, both finite abs<=.4; preserve float64 through admission and loss
record.mode_discrepancy: Reject fixed batch; preserve every source row and planned status. No dropping, replacement or teacher-mode seeding.
record.modes: teacher_mode_before/after uint8 scalar codes1/2; supervisor_mode_before/after uint8 scalar codes0/1; all independently checked from reset
record.sensors: inputs float32[8], unchanged virtual sensor contract
record.student_input: student_inputs float32[9], last component independently reconstructed BEFORE-mode

scope: Hybrid fixed phase-memory supervisor plus learned continuous velocity and heading; phase transitions are not learned. Production Engine, models, task/physics files unchanged. No collection/training/held-out execution authorized by this source commit.

supervisor.arithmetic: Validate float32[8], cast first four components to float64 before multiplying by 14. Compute body-frame goal-minus-puck and math.hypot distance. Stop distance <=.18 returns current mode BEFORE unit-vector division, including coincident goal. Otherwise use scalar float64 products/sums for axial, absolute cross product for lateral, and math.hypot(puck-.55*unit_goal) for arrival. No rounding, clipping or privileged state.
supervisor.commit: Stage from current sensors/cursor. Only replace cursor after one completed interval with exact next tick. Failed inference/action admission/step cannot commit candidate state. No teacher/private-world access at student inference.
supervisor.input_nine: own carried mode BEFORE this decision, float32 0 or 1
supervisor.transitions: approach -> push only on ready AND arrival<=.08; push -> approach only when not ready; otherwise carry; equality included

unchanged_task_contract: Resolve layouts, limits and eight-sensor observation directly from the pinned task protocol. Resolve learning hyperparameters and admission thresholds from that same file, with only the explicit architecture and sensor_teacher_mode_agreement additions here. All 32 IDs/splits, three training seeds, epochs/optimizer/thresholds/bounds remain identical.
